item.title: Grace Hopper Didn't Wait for Permission. Neither Should We.
item.description: GHC is canceled. The way we work, hire and learn in tech has changed, and how we invest in community is changing with it. Here's where the energy goes next, starting with PyLadiesCon on December 5–7.
item.dc:creator: Lorena Mesa

item.title: The Refit: What Python 3.15 Actually Looks Like When You Ship It
item.description: Python 3.15 final shipped today. Here's what it actually looks like in production — lazy imports, frozendict, sentinel, a stdlib sampling profiler, and a 7-12% JIT — in EventLoop, a Chicago events chatbot on Python 3.15, uv, FastAPI and PydanticAI.
item.dc:creator: Lorena Mesa
